mark.about: The symbol. An inline `<svg>` is ideal; anything that renders works.

word.about: The name, as it is set. Also the accessible name unless `label` says otherwise.

tagline.about: Shown at FULL only — the one stage with room for it.

smStage.about: Which of the two same-size stages this brand uses at >= 80px. Not a size question, which is why it cannot be a query: it asks whether the brand survives as a symbol or as type. A monogram in a square

stage.about: Pin a stage and ignore the container. For specimen sheets, where six stages have to appear in six boxes of the same width — the one case where the container is the wrong thing to ask. Leave it unset i

href.about: Wrap in a link. A logo in a header is nearly always the way home.

label.about: Accessible name. Defaults to the wordmark, then to "Logo".
